description: Tiknix duplicate/anti-pattern definitions. Patterns are PHP regex (JSON-escaped). Severity: critical|high|medium|low. Optional 'exclude' is a path regex for files that are the legitimate home of the pattern.

Hand-rolled authcontrol row.suggestion: Use PermissionCache::seedRule($controller, $method, $level, $desc) - a hand-written row silently loses to the ADMIN-default row the framework auto-creates on first request

Direct R:: call (use Bean::).suggestion: Use the Bean:: wrapper - it normalizes bean type names, so R::dispense('orderItem') throws 'Invalid bean type' at runtime while Bean::dispense('orderItem') works. Legitimate raw R:: is limited to bootstrap connection setup and schema seeds

Direct R::exec for CRUD.suggestion: Use bean operations (Bean::dispense/store/trash) - raw SQL bypasses FUSE model hooks entirely

Manual JSON response.suggestion: Use Flight::jsonSuccess()/Flight::jsonError() so envelope and status codes stay consistent

Flight jsonError + return.suggestion: Frequent 2-line idiom - consider a base-class helper that emits and returns in one call

Bean findOne + not found check.suggestion: Consider Bean::findOneOrFail() that throws on not found

Hardcoded permission level.suggestion: Use LEVELS['ROOT'|'ADMIN'|'MEMBER'|'PUBLIC'] - hardcoded ints drift when levels change and do not render in UI dropdowns

Manual logger fetch.suggestion: Controllers already have $this->logger from BaseControls\Control - only stateless/CLI classes need to fetch it

requireLogin guard.suggestion: Established idiom, but a middleware/attribute would remove the repetition

try-catch with logger.suggestion: Standard pattern, but consider a withErrorHandling() wrapper

Hyphenated controller/method name.suggestion: Hyphens cannot map to PHP class/method names - use lowercase single words so DefaultRoute auto-routes without a route file
